codeReview.summary: The implementation fully satisfies the feature requirements. All three @pytest.mark.skip decorators have been removed (verified via grep). Tests exercise real API surfaces with substantive assertions rather than trivial mocks. The pipeline_engine.py placeholder fix is appropriate — returning structured 'skipped' payloads instead of misleading 'Not implemented yet' strings, while preserving the existing try/except error handling structure. The test files went from 598+688+607 lines of stale mocked code to 190+130+155 lines of focused, real-API tests. No bugs or edge cases were missed.

issues.description: The try/except blocks around the new 'skipped' return statements are dead code — a dict literal return cannot raise an exception. The except clauses for malware_analysis (line ~1135), ml_analysis (line ~1185), and report_generation (line ~1290) are unreachable. This is a pre-existing pattern from the original code, not introduced by this PR, but the worker could have cleaned it up while editing these blocks.

Dead try/except blocks: The 'skipped' dict return statements in pipeline_engine.py for malware, ML, and report stages are wrapped in try/except that can never trigger. This is inherited from the original code structure but was a missed opportunity to clean up during this edit.
